related_declarations.provides: A candidate's objective value is at least every value on the set; membership, selection and uniqueness are separate requirements.

searches.mechanism: Archive-pinned local rg search and direct declaration/body inspection
searches.query: Search marginal likelihood maximum estimator and inspect IsMaxOn membership/selection requirements.
searches.result: IsMaxOn can state optimality of the product marginal likelihood, but well-definedness and a measurable choice are additional requirements.

library_audit.gap: The marginal MLE still needs admissible membership, existence and a measurable selection from any ties.

variant_reviews.comparison: For J positive use radius c/sqrt(J), c fixed positive, center the closed Euclidean ball at the exact MLE and normalize Lebesgue volume; IsUniform is a law predicate, not proof of valid positive finite volume or an executable sampler. Then independently draw each theta_j from p(theta_j|Y_j,psi), sharing sampled psi, and reorder joint coordinates to (theta,psi) as printed. Do not intersect the ball with a constrained domain without source authority; a conditional version only defined predictively almost everywhere may need extension at sampled psi. Preserve l versus ell notation and growing dimension, without asserting a fixed deterministic warmness bound or arbitrary-first-block extension as the original formula.
